statement: Cemu 29f2f1f ARM64 native Wiimote with imported synthetic EEPROM, MP and Nunchuk blocks in the MP+Nunchuk profile passes the base EEPROM read, then remains in mapped/unmapped identity initialization exchange, including A600FA error 7. Its 44 A40020/16 reads succeed and match the active MP block first half, not the Nunchuk block; preceding native identity observations include mapped MP. A preexisting foreign browser companion holder was present; the clean no-holder preflight was blocked before application launch. This is an explicit coexistence comparison, not a clean retest of the original Nunchuk calibration path or a decoded-gyro pass. No library wrong-bank defect, sole-actor race cause or physical incompatibility is inferred.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Bounded coexistence observation, not a clean no-holder retest. Correct mapped-bank delivery is distinct from application decoding; no calibrated-rate, physical, radio or game promotion.
